thread:
Priya Shah: Heads-up — LumenTech onboarding SLA alignment call tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need to confirm uptime target 99.95% and p99 latency <= 350ms for the dedicated cluster. Customer asked how credits would be calculated if we miss targets; renewal contact flagged as elevated risk. cc @Ethan Cole @Marta Ruiz

Ethan Cole: Got it. I pulled the initial uptime numbers — infra shows 99.96% for the last 30d. Latency p99 spikes on long-prefix requests. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/lumentech

Marta Ruiz: I'll own the credits calc for the call. Quick Q: do we use rolling 30d or calendar month for their contract? Contract language says 'monthly measurement window' — I'll confirm with legal.

Priya Shah: Thanks. Can you prepare sample credit calc table for both windows? Customer wants example numbers. Also need runbook excerpt for incident compensation.

Marta Ruiz: On it. Sample SQL for monthly uptime below:
`````
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC(timestamp, MONTH) as month,
  SUM(successful)/SUM(total) as uptime
FROM metrics.requests
WHERE customer_id='lumentech'
GROUP BY month
`````
Will include credit example rows (0.5% short -> 10% service credit, etc.).

Ethan Cole: For latency, here's a quick prom query to get p99 tail for their dedicated model route:
`````
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[30d])) by (le))
`````

Priya Shah: :thumbsup: Good. Also capture enablement notes — their on-call is in APAC, so handoff timing matters. @Marta please flag any configuration changes that could affect latency before the call.

Marta Ruiz: Noted. I'll include a short list of tuning knobs: batching.max_tokens, kv_cache size, dynamic_padding. Will also attach before/after benchmark numbers.

Priya Shah: Risk note: renewal advocate says customer mentioned 'migration to competitor if credits unclear' — would like a clear SLA appendix. Can we draft one pager and an example clause?

Ethan Cole: I can draft the appendix: include measurement windows, sample credits table, and fallback policy (automatic model downgrade to maintain latency SLO). I'll add a fallback examples section.

Priya Shah: Perfect. Action items:
- Marta: sample credit calc + runbook excerpt + tuning list (due EOD today)
- Ethan: SLA appendix draft + dashboard shortlink + fallback policy (due EOD)
- Priya: coordinate call invite and capture feedback post-call
I'll post materials in the thread and ping @cs-bot to attach to the customer's onboarding ticket.

cs-bot: Attachment added to ticket #CN-4982: /attachments/2276543210-lumentech-sla-pkg.pdf

Marta Ruiz: Uploaded calc sheet here: https://drive.google.com/sheet/lumentech-sla-calc (I left commented rows with assumptions: measurement window, exclusion windows for planned maintenance)

Ethan Cole: Appendix PR: https://git.redwood/repo/sla-templates/pull/45 — feel free to comment on the sample clause about credit proration.

Priya Shah: Thanks all. We'll sync 9:30am PT to review before the 10am customer meeting. Please add any blockers here.
